document.about: Eppendorf Multipette E3/E3x performance data sheet (2 pages). Its technical specifications are a list of fields, `Label | value` down two columns, ruled under every row and set in one face throughout, with no header row.

notes: 2026-11-23: the field list's first row was read as its header, so every value was named after the first field (`1 µL – 50,000 µL` under `Positive displacement dispenser`) and the first field was lost as a row (#51).

checks.issue: The first field was taken for the table's header and was not a row of it.
Every value carried the first field's value as its column name.
The four fields with values several lines tall (Intended use, Storage accessories, Operating conditions, Others) fall out of the table, and their values run together as one paragraph.
